support.name: setup
support.description: Open the interactive Auralis server configuration panel.

support.name: help
support.description: Browse command categories. Each entry shows required and optional options.

support.name: panel
support.description: Send a saved ticket, application, verification or staff panel to a channel.

support.name: tickets list
support.description: List currently open support tickets for this server.

support.name: tickets panel
support.description: Send a saved ticket panel to the current channel. The panel name or ID is optional.

support.name: tickets stats
support.description: Show total and open ticket counts.

support.name: tickets leaderboard
support.description: Show ticket staff ranked by closes.

support.name: applications panel
support.description: Post a saved application panel. The panel ID is optional when a default is configured.

support.name: applications list
support.description: List applications; optionally filter by pending, accepted, rejected or all.

support.name: applications review
support.description: Review a submission by ID, select Accept or Reject, and optionally include a reason.

support.name: close
support.description: Close the current ticket.

support.name: add
support.description: Add a member to the current ticket.

support.name: remove
support.description: Remove a member from the current ticket.

support.name: picperms
support.description: Toggle image permissions for a member.

support.name: stats
support.description: Show server ticket and moderation statistics.

support.name: leaderboard
support.description: Show the staff leaderboard by ticket closes.

support.name: staffactivity panel
support.description: Post the activity panel, optionally in a selected channel.

support.name: staffactivity check
support.description: Check a selected staff member or yourself when no user is selected.

support.name: staffactivity leaderboard
support.description: Show staff activity rankings, optionally on a selected page.

support.name: commands
support.description: Enable or disable a prefix command for this server.

moderation.name: warn
moderation.description: Warn a member, record a case and optionally send a DM. A reason can be required per server in Dashboard → Moderation.

moderation.name: warnings
moderation.description: Show the warning history for a member.

moderation.name: unwarn
moderation.description: Remove one active warning while keeping its moderation history.

moderation.name: clearwarnings
moderation.description: Clear active warnings without deleting the audit history.

moderation.name: punishmentstats
moderation.description: Show recorded punishment totals for a member.

moderation.name: history
moderation.description: Show the full moderation case history for a member.

moderation.name: caselog
moderation.description: Inspect a single moderation case.

moderation.name: reason
moderation.description: Update the reason stored on a moderation case.

moderation.name: ban
moderation.description: Permanently ban a member and record a case.

moderation.name: unban
moderation.description: Remove a ban by Discord user ID and record the reason in the case history.

moderation.name: banlist
moderation.description: Show the server ban list with pagination.

moderation.name: tempban
moderation.description: Temporarily ban a member and unban them automatically. A reason can be required per server in Dashboard → Moderation.

moderation.name: kick
moderation.description: Kick a member and record a case.

moderation.name: kicklist
moderation.description: Show the most recent member kicks recorded by Auralis.

moderation.name: mute
moderation.description: Apply a Discord timeout for the selected duration.

moderation.name: tempmute
moderation.description: Temporarily timeout a member; Discord enforces the 28-day limit.

moderation.name: unmute
moderation.description: Remove an active Discord timeout; optional reason is included in the audit log.

moderation.name: pardon
moderation.description: Clear a member’s active warnings and preserve the history.

moderation.name: punish
moderation.description: Apply a Discord timeout for the selected duration; reason is optional unless configured as required.

moderation.name: unpunish
moderation.description: Remove a member timeout. This command uses the server prefix.

moderation.name: untimeoutall
moderation.description: Remove active timeouts from manageable members.

moderation.name: purge
moderation.description: Bulk delete recent messages.

moderation.name: cleanup
moderation.description: Delete bot and command messages.

moderation.name: lockdown
moderation.description: Lock a text channel for regular members.

moderation.name: unlock
moderation.description: Unlock a text channel.

moderation.name: lockdownall
moderation.description: Lock every manageable text channel.

moderation.name: unlockdownall
moderation.description: Unlock every manageable text channel.

moderation.name: strip
moderation.description: Remove all manageable roles from a member.

moderation.name: jail
moderation.description: Move a member into the configured jail state.

moderation.name: unjail
moderation.description: Release a jailed member and restore roles.

moderation.name: jailed
moderation.description: Show members who are currently jailed.

moderation.name: setjail
moderation.description: Configure the jail role and channel.

moderation.name: setjailauto
moderation.description: Configure automatic jail settings.

moderation.name: hide
moderation.description: Hide a channel from a role or member.

moderation.name: unhide
moderation.description: Reveal a channel again.

moderation.name: slowmode
moderation.description: Set channel slowmode in seconds.

moderation.name: nsfw
moderation.description: Toggle a channel NSFW state.

moderation.name: audit
moderation.description: Inspect recent Discord audit log entries.

moderation.name: rollback
moderation.description: Review the latest moderation rollback. This command uses the server prefix.

moderation.name: pin
moderation.description: Pin a message using its Discord message link.

moderation.name: unpin
moderation.description: Unpin a message using its Discord message link.

security.name: antinuke
security.description: View or change Auralis anti-nuke protection modules.

security.name: verify
security.description: Configure or publish the verification panel.

security.name: honeypot add
security.description: Enable the honeypot rule in a channel.

security.name: honeypot remove
security.description: Disable the honeypot rule in a channel.

security.name: honeypot configure
security.description: Configure honeypot state, threshold and response action.

security.name: imgonly add
security.description: Require image attachments in a channel.

security.name: imgonly remove
security.description: Remove image-only protection from a channel.

community.name: timezone
community.description: Set or view a member timezone.

community.name: level rank
community.description: Show your level or the selected member’s level.

community.name: level addrole
community.description: Assign a role reward to a level.

community.name: level removerole
community.description: Remove the role reward from a level.

community.name: levelup
community.description: Show the level rank for a member.

community.name: autorole add
community.description: Add a role to the join-time automatic role list.

community.name: autorole remove
community.description: Remove a role from the join-time automatic role list.

community.name: reactionrole add
community.description: Link an emoji on a bot message to a role.

community.name: reactionrole removeall
community.description: Remove all reaction-role mappings for a message.

community.name: buttonrole add
community.description: Add a role button to an existing bot message; style, emoji and label are optional.

community.name: buttonrole remove
community.description: Remove one role button by index.

community.name: buttonrole removeall
community.description: Remove every role button on the message.

community.name: tag get
community.description: Display the saved text and content for a named server tag.

community.name: tag edit
community.description: Replace the saved content for an existing tag name.

community.name: tag remove
community.description: Delete a saved tag from this server after checking its name.

community.name: tag list
community.description: List the reusable tags configured for this server.

community.name: sticky set
community.description: Set the sticky message for the current channel.

community.name: sticky remove
community.description: Remove the sticky message from the current channel.

community.name: counter add
community.description: Create a live count channel for the selected metric.

utility.name: serverinfo
utility.description: Show information about the current Discord server.

utility.name: userinfo
utility.description: Show information about a Discord user.

utility.name: roles
utility.description: List server roles with their names and role information.

utility.name: inrole
utility.description: List members who have a specific role.

utility.name: boomer
utility.description: Show the oldest members in the server.

utility.name: translate
utility.description: Translate text to a selected language.

utility.name: template view
utility.description: View configured moderation and event response templates.

utility.name: template set
utility.description: Set the response template for an event.

utility.name: template reset
utility.description: Reset one template to its default.

utility.name: webhook delete
utility.description: Delete a saved webhook by ID.

utility.name: webhook send
utility.description: Send a message through a saved webhook.

prefix.name: snipe
prefix.description: Show the latest deleted messages

prefix.name: editsnipe
prefix.description: Show the latest edited message

prefix.name: reactionsnipe
prefix.description: Show the latest removed reaction

prefix.name: clearsnipe
prefix.description: Clear the snipe cache for this channel

prefix.name: snipeprotect
prefix.description: Toggle snipe protection

prefix.name: say
prefix.description: Send the provided message as Auralis; requires staff access

prefix.name: 8ball
prefix.description: Give a playful answer to your question

prefix.name: choose
prefix.description: Choose one item from the options you provide

prefix.name: coinflip
prefix.description: Flip a virtual coin and return either heads or tails.

prefix.name: rps
prefix.description: Play rock paper scissors

prefix.name: dice
prefix.description: Roll one or more dice and show each result plus the total.

prefix.name: howgay
prefix.description: Generate a clearly playful compatibility-style percentage for a member

prefix.name: pp
prefix.description: Generate a silly, non-serious size percentage for a member

prefix.name: iq
prefix.description: Generate a playful IQ-style score for a member

prefix.name: uwuify
prefix.description: Transform supplied text into a playful uwu-style message

prefix.name: quote
prefix.description: Quote a message or the text you provide

prefix.name: urbandictionary
prefix.description: Look up a term in Urban Dictionary

prefix.name: bible
prefix.description: Show a random Bible verse from the built-in King James Version selection

prefix.name: ship
prefix.description: Calculate a deterministic compatibility score

prefix.name: rate
prefix.description: Rate the supplied topic on a playful 0–10 scale

prefix.name: roast
prefix.description: Generate a light, playful roast for a member

prefix.name: rizz
prefix.description: Generate a playful pickup line for a member

prefix.name: howautistic
prefix.description: Generate a non-serious random percentage; this is only a joke and not a real assessment

prefix.name: hot
prefix.description: Generate a playful hotness rating for a member

prefix.name: simp
prefix.description: Generate a playful simp rating for a member

prefix.name: braincells
prefix.description: Generate a silly braincell count for a member

prefix.name: cursed
prefix.description: Generate a playful cursed percentage for a member

prefix.name: luck
prefix.description: Show a playful luck percentage for you

prefix.name: fact
prefix.description: Fetch and share a random general-interest fact

prefix.name: joke
prefix.description: Fetch and share a random joke

prefix.name: reverse
prefix.description: Reverse the text you provide

prefix.name: mock
prefix.description: Transform text into alternating capitalization

prefix.name: math
prefix.description: Calculate a mathematical expression using +, -, *, / and parentheses

prefix.name: lyrics
prefix.description: Search for a song’s lyrics using the song title and optional artist

prefix.name: qr
prefix.description: Generate a QR code from the text or URL you provide

prefix.name: balance
prefix.description: Show a wallet balance

prefix.name: bank
prefix.description: Show wallet and bank balance

prefix.name: deposit
prefix.description: Move coins into the bank

prefix.name: withdraw
prefix.description: Move coins out of the bank

prefix.name: bankup
prefix.description: Increase bank capacity

prefix.name: daily
prefix.description: Claim the daily reward

prefix.name: work
prefix.description: Claim a configured work reward when your work cooldown is ready.

prefix.name: give
prefix.description: Send coins to another member

prefix.name: cooldowns
prefix.description: Show active cooldowns

prefix.name: gamble
prefix.description: Risk wallet coins on a configurable win chance; gambling can be disabled by admins.

prefix.name: rob
prefix.description: Attempt to rob another server member. Success transfers a portion of their wallet; failure may cost you a fine.

prefix.name: baltop
prefix.description: Show the server money leaderboard

prefix.name: badges
prefix.description: Show the Auralis badges and activity milestones associated with your account.

prefix.name: github
prefix.description: Look up a public GitHub profile

prefix.name: roblox
prefix.description: Look up a Roblox user profile

prefix.name: rotate
prefix.description: Rotate an attached image and return the processed file; defaults to 90 degrees

prefix.name: compress
prefix.description: Compress an attached image to WebP; quality must be between 20 and 95

prefix.name: invert
prefix.description: Invert the colours of an attached image and return a PNG
